title: Module profile porblem under user "roles and permission" tab

posts.name: Jlfernandez83
posts.cooked:
Hello everyone, first of all, thank you very much for your time.

I’m using the develop branch of ERPNext, and I’m not sure whether the issue I’m seeing is due to a misunderstanding on my part, or an actual problem in the system.

My understanding is that roles control who can do what (CRUD operations on the doctypes associated with the role), and that module access basically controls access to the workspaces defined by that module. Is this correct?

However, if I uncheck all of them, the system still shows a sidebar with all ERPNext elements. This happens consistently — whatever I check or uncheck there seems to have no effect.

Let me know if you need further information.

posts.name: Jlfernandez83
posts.cooked:
Thanks both of you for your responses. So:

  • What’s the porpouse of the “allowed modules” section in the user’s ‘roles and permissions’ tab?
  • @Prytesh according to you, that means you are required to change ERPNext’ workspaces definition to avoid certain users to have the links shown in the side bar?

posts.name: Priytesh
posts.cooked:
Exactly

The “Allowed Modules” section in the User doctype is legacy — it used to control which modules appeared in the sidebar. On current develop branch, it no longer hides or restricts access by itself.

  • Roles → control CRUD permissions on DocTypes.
  • Allowed Modules → only a UI preference (whether a module shortcut used to be shown). It doesn’t override roles.
  • Workspaces → now drive what shows in the sidebar. Each workspace can be restricted to certain roles.

So yes: if you want to prevent users from seeing certain links in the sidebar, you should adjust the Workspace definitions (set role restrictions there). The “Allowed Modules” checkboxes don’t enforce this anymore.
